name: Barbell 21s
description: A barbell curl protocol using 21 total repetitions split into three segments: 7 reps from the bottom to the midpoint, 7 reps from the midpoint to the top, and 7 full-range reps. Each segment targets a different portion of the strength curve and produces significant metabolic stress in the biceps.

execution.starting_position: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms fully extended.
execution.setup_instructions: Select a weight approximately 60-70% of your normal curl working weight. Stand tall with the bar hanging in front.
steps: Step 1 (reps 1-7): Curl from full extension to the midpoint only (forearms parallel to floor). Lower back down and repeat 7 times.
Step 2 (reps 8-14): Start from the midpoint and curl to full contraction at the top. Lower back to midpoint and repeat 7 times.
Step 3 (reps 15-21): Perform 7 full-range curls from full extension to full contraction.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe rhythmically throughout each segment. Exhale on the curl, inhale on the lower.
common_mistakes: Using too heavy a weight — the third segment of full reps becomes impossible
safety_considerations: All 21 reps are performed without putting the bar down
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Partial ranges in segments 1 and 2, full range in segment 3.
coaching_cues: Feel the pump build through each set
